== English Reflections III comparison ==
The original applies the exception only if an enemy non-alien is present at the site. The contemporary rules example excludes a character aboard an enclosed vehicle. The published replacement checks whether the opponent's non-alien is here, which includes the enclosed vehicle at that same site. The related-site drain cancellation, twice-per-game limit and conditional immunity remain.
